answer: The pearl multiplier is published, charged in terrace, and ripple lists each payment. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 18 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A farm of 3099 identities would post 2990 proofs and burn roughly 86 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
